description: This file contains a function 'get_merge_query' that generates SQL queries for merging modules in the SuiteCRM system. It defines relationships between different modules such as Contacts, Opportunities, and Accounts, and constructs queries based on these relationships.

methods.name: get_merge_query
methods.description: Generates a SQL query string to retrieve related records for merging modules in SuiteCRM based on the specified seed object, merge module, and key.
